final_message:
Configured the DNS hierarchy on pc1–pc13, including the requested delegations, glue, A and MX records. pc14 is configured as the recursive resolver with pc1 as its root hint, and pc16–pc20 use pc14 for DNS. The existing topology, addresses, and routes were preserved.

The lab had no configured web service, so `www.example.com` points to pc15’s existing address, `10.14.5.11`. This does not install a web server. The configuration and example queries are documented in [DNS-README.md](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-shysufbz/lab/DNS-README.md).

The modified startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. I could not run the lab or validate BIND at runtime because Docker access was denied; the PC images must provide BIND 9’s `named` executable.
